movies.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
movies.overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction.

movies.title: Michael
